text.tspan: KV cache: saves recomputation, costs GPU memory
token 500 recomputes K and V for all 499 earlier tokens
K and V computed once per token, kept in GPU memory,
32 layers × 8 KV heads × 128 × 2 (K and V) × 2 bytes
≈ 128 KB per token → an 8,000-token chat ≈ 1 GB
One H100 = 80 GB of GPU memory
KV cache of every active request: ~60 GB
The KV cache, not the maths, limits how many users one GPU can serve.
Attention looks back at every earlier token: Key = what a token is about (folder label), Value = what it carries (contents).
